evidence.quoted_text:
if is_dir and name.endswith(".d") and name[:-2] in units:
                foreign.append("undeclared drop-in directory: " + str(entry))
evidence.reason: Line 563 rejects only exact-unit drop-in directories because it checks `name[:-2] in units`. Systemd also applies type-wide `service.d/` drop-ins, and dash-prefix drop-ins can apply without starting with the selected unit's `prefix`, so line 556 does not reject them either. A `.conf` that only changes service settings can therefore leave discovery at `supported=True` despite an applicable shared drop-in altering the selected unit's effective configuration.
